title: Water Sommeliers Say the Simplest Drink Is the Future of Luxury

sentences: Six Esteemed sommeliers sit silently behind a judging table.
A waiter tops up their glasses one by one and they appraise the stuff: sniff, hold it to the light, sometimes swirl, sip, swish between cheeks, dump the extras and give it a score.
But the liquid is no Zinfandel or Syrah.
Instead the bon viveurs are tasting high-end waters.
translations: 六位德高望重的侍酒师静静地坐在评审桌后。
一名服务员逐一斟满他们的酒杯，他们则品鉴这液体：闻香、对着光观察、有时摇晃、啜饮、在口腔中搅动、倒掉多余的，然后打分。
但这液体并非仙粉黛或西拉葡萄酒。
相反，这些享乐主义者正在品尝高端水。

sentences: The competition launched this year's Fine Water Summit in the swanky Buckhead neighbourhood of Atlanta, Georgia.
With 1,100 bottles imported from 35 countries it is the biggest event of its sort.

The assembled connoisseurs — hailing from France and California — have paid $975 each for a weekend of talks and tastings co-ordinated by Michael Mascha, the group's Austrian founder who lives in Texas's Rio Grande Valley.
Most are middle-aged, very foodie and unusually fit.
translations: 这场竞赛在佐治亚州亚特兰大市时髦的巴克黑德社区拉开了今年精品水峰会的序幕。
此次峰会从35个国家进口了1100瓶水，是同类活动中规模最大的一次。
这些来自法国和加利福尼亚的品鉴专家们，每人支付了975美元，参加由该组织奥地利创始人迈克尔·马沙协调的周末讲座和品鉴活动，马沙现居得克萨斯州里奥格兰德河谷。
他们大多中年，非常热爱美食，且身体异常健康。

sentences: Many are amongst the 250 water sommeliers ordained by Mr Mascha's academy.
Months of training have taught them to appreciate how minerality changes water's flavour, how silica affects its mouth-feel and the size of bubbles its acidity.
translations: 许多人属于由马沙先生学院任命的250名水侍酒师之列。
数月的训练教会了他们欣赏矿物质如何改变水的味道，二氧化硅如何影响其口感，以及酸度如何影响气泡的大小。

sentences: The waters taste as different from each other as wines do.
One from the glaciers of the Lofoten Islands in Norway does indeed taste like melted snow.
Another from the highest volcano in the Andes Mountains in Peru is bitter and salty — not your correspondent's favourite.
translations: 这些水的味道彼此不同，就像葡萄酒一样。
其中一种来自挪威罗弗敦群岛的冰川，尝起来确实像融化的雪。
另一种来自秘鲁安第斯山脉最高火山的水又苦又咸——不是本通讯记者最喜欢的。

sentences: Nico Pieterse, a sommelier who runs a tasting room on South Africa's western cape, likes to pair the first with sashimi and the second with fried foods or anchovy pizza.
As the attendees sample still and sparkling varieties, Mr Mascha comes by with a particularly spectacular bottle.
The "Fromin" is 15,000-year-old ice-age water from what is now the Czech Republic.
Floating in it are flakes of gold.
"I don't bring wine to parties, I bring this," he says, "for the rest of the evening no one wants champagne anymore".
translations: 尼科·皮特斯是南非西开普省一家品酒室的侍酒师，他喜欢将前者与生鱼片搭配，将后者与油炸食品或鳀鱼披萨搭配。
当与会者品尝静止型和起泡型酒款时，马沙先生带着一瓶格外引人注目的酒走了过来。
这款“弗罗明”是来自如今捷克共和国的15000年前的冰河时代水。
其中漂浮着金箔碎片。
“我去派对不带葡萄酒，我带这个，”他说，“当晚余下的时间里，没人再想喝香槟了。”

sentences: Mr Mascha is a food anthropologist who collected wine before his doctor told him to ditch it.
For ten years after he switched over to fine water he was mercilessly mocked: at a live television event in Las Vegas he was given toilet water to taste.
Now nearly 40 restaurants, some with Michelin stars, offer full "water menus", thanks to his evangelising.
Youngsters less keen on booze are taking notice.
translations: 马沙先生是一位食品人类学家，在医生让他戒酒之前，他曾收藏葡萄酒。
在他转向精品水之后的十年里，他无情地遭到嘲笑：在拉斯维加斯的一场电视直播活动中，有人给他品尝马桶水。
如今，得益于他的大力宣传，近40家餐厅（其中一些拥有米其林星级）提供完整的“水单”。
对酒类兴趣不大的年轻人开始注意到这一点。

sentences: Doran Binder, an effusive blonde-bearded sommelier, has gone viral on TikTok.
After buying a failing pub in the English countryside he discovered that his land produced some of the world's "creamiest" water.
He now sells trendy cans of it by subscription.

He reckons corporate water companies are scamming people into drinking poison-infused water; restaurants too often ruin the good stuff by serving it with "chlorinated ice cubes and a slice of fucking lemon".
translations: 多兰·宾德，一位热情洋溢、留着金色胡须的侍酒师，在TikTok上走红了。
在买下英格兰乡村一家经营不善的酒吧后，他发现自己的土地出产了世界上“最丝滑”的水。
他现在以订阅制销售这种时髦罐装水。
他认为企业水务公司是在骗人们喝掺了毒的水；餐厅也常常用“加氯冰块和一片该死的柠檬”来糟蹋好水。

sentences: The summit is sponsored by Lake, a cryptocurrency firm that wants to decentralise the water industry.
The aqua enthusiasts are eager for more people to invest.
Elena Berg, a sommelier who doubles as an environmental scientist at a Parisian college, sees the movement as a way to talk about how precious clean water is as climate change threatens access to it.
translations: 此次峰会由Lake赞助，这是一家希望将水务行业去中心化的加密货币公司。
这些水爱好者渴望更多人投资。
埃琳娜·伯格是一名侍酒师，同时兼任巴黎一所学院的环境科学家，她将这一运动视为一种方式，用以讨论清洁水在气候变化威胁其获取途径时的珍贵性。

sentences: But to many in Atlanta this weekend it is more about enjoying life's small pleasures.
Mr Pieterse, the South African, wants to put scannable barcodes on the bottles so you can listen to the water trickling at its source while sipping it.
Doing so would allow customers to simply revel in the fact that they are drinking something that a mammoth once drank too.
translations: 但对本周末在亚特兰大的许多人来说，这更多是关于享受生活中的小乐趣。
南非人彼得斯先生想在瓶子上贴上可扫描的条形码，这样你在啜饮时就能听到水源处的水流声。
这样做能让顾客单纯地陶醉于这样一个事实：他们正在喝的东西，猛犸象也曾喝过。
